_doc: Default Anthropic model IDs for the api backend (docs/domain.md §6). The only place outside the environment that names model IDs: a non-empty MODEL_STRUCTURE / MODEL_PII / MODEL_REPORT always wins. Keep in sync with .env.example (tests/ai-api.test.ts checks). The claude-cli backend uses CLAUDE_CLI_MODEL (an alias, default sonnet) instead.

families._doc: What each known model accepts in an api request (lib/ai/backends/api.ts apiRequestShape; docs/decisions.md 2026-10-20 'api request shape'). Checked against Anthropic's documentation on 2026-10-20: the Opus 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5 / Haiku 5.5 migration guides and the API errors page ('Forced tool use not supported' names Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1; Haiku 5.5 accepts a forced tool_choice), and the structured-outputs page (strict tools on these models). There is no sampling flag: API version 2026-10-21 (@anthropic-ai/sdk 1.x) rejects temperature, top_p and top_k on every model, so none is ever sent (issue #17). forcedToolChoice: tool_choice type tool is accepted. effort: output_config.effort is accepted (so the per-function default effort is sent). strictTools: strict: true on the tool is accepted. A model not listed here gets the plain shape: tool_choice auto, no default effort, no strict; the AI_API_* knobs a human sets are sent as set. The same ID with an 8-digit date suffix (e.g. -20261001) matches its family.
